17/G.goal: Explain the basic IMU-based tracking pipeline used in XR systems to estimate orientation from sensor data while reducing drift and measurement error.
17/G.achieves: It provides the conceptual grounding for XR tracking technologies that supports the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence.

17/O1.goal: Explain how an IMU-based tracking system estimates and updates orientation by calibrating sensor readings, registering an initial orientation, integrating calibrated angular velocity, and applying drift correction.
17/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a foundational understanding of sensor-based tracking and orientation error correction, helping them understand XR hardware and the tracking issues addressed later in XR development and optimization.
